test_density_shapes: test that NormalDistribution, MultivariateNormalDistribution, ChallengingTwoDimensionalMixture, and FunnelDistribution return correct log density shapes
test_vae_digit_ordering: test that AutoEncoderLikelihood loads the correct digit image by index using MD5 hash verification
test_vae_batching_consistency: test that AutoEncoderLikelihood batched log density output matches per-sample total_log_probability calls
test_phi_four_symmetry: test that phi_four_log_density is invariant under reflection and translation of lattice values
test_phi_four_zero: test that phi_four_log_density returns zero when all lattice values are zero
